{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Id": "__default_policy_ID",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "__owner_statement",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "*"
      },
      "Action": "SQS:*"
    }
  ]
}

        RESPONSE:
{
  "message": "Invalid JSON policy document. The policy must be expressed as a series of IAM policy statements. Each statement must contain the following fields: Sid (required), Effect (required), Action (required), and either Principal or NotPrincipal (required). For more information about building AWS IAM policies, see AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) Policies. For more information about the elements that make up an IAM policy document, see IAM JSON Policy Reference. If you have invalid characters in your policy document, you can troubleshoot and correct the issue by using an editor that supports regular expressions. If you continue to have issues, you can contact AWS customer support."
}
